Students enrolled in the online Master of Arts in Interreligious Dialogue: Science, Philosophy, and Theology of Religions may apply for financial support to help cover tuition costs.
The tuition fees for the program amount to CHF 1,100 per semester. Payment at the beginning of each semester is required to confirm or renew enrollment.
To support students financially, scholarships are available.
Each scholarship offers a tuition reduction ranging from CHF 500 to CHF 1,100 per semester, depending on the applicant’s situation and motivation.
Applicants interested in financial aid must submit a motivation letter explaining their reasons for enrolling in the program and requesting support. Requests must be sent via e-mail to bds.ftl@usi.ch.
Please note the following deadlines:

  • 31 March: for scholarship renewal (spring semester only or the following academic year)
  • 30 June: for first-time applications for the following academic year only

Scholarship recipients are still required to pay the first semester fee (CHF 1,100) in order to formally confirm their enrollment.
For more information, please visit the official website of Facoltà di Teologia di Lugano:
https://www.ftl.usi.ch/it/didattica/scholarships.
